dedupe_keys.name: hong kong energy end use data

description: EMSD publishes Hong Kong Energy End-use Data on energy consumption by fuel and purpose, including uses such as lighting, cooking and air conditioning. The series supports policy assessment and understanding of demand patterns. The provider is Electrical and Mechanical Services Department. Coverage: Coverage is Hong Kong. Individual editions and consumption surveys have their own periods; this landing page does not establish one full historical span or fine spatial resolution. Access: The agency states that the publication is free and provides edition and additional-data request links. Documents and survey data were not downloaded. Licence and cost: The page does not establish a reuse licence or complete cost conditions. Provider confirmation is required before reuse. Limitations: Published aggregates do not establish household-level profiles or hourly loads. Reuse terms and edition-specific methods require checking. For simulation it supplies territorial energy-demand composition and end-use calibration evidence. Related resources: This territorial end-use series differs from the utility generation and sales series reviewed separately.
